Resolution criteria:
- "San Francisco Giants": Wins if the San Francisco Giants finish the August 20, 2026 MLB game against the Cleveland Guardians at Progressive Field with a higher run total than the Guardians at the conclusion of all regulation and any extra innings played.
- "Cleveland Guardians": Wins if the Cleveland Guardians finish the August 20, 2026 MLB game against the San Francisco Giants at Progressive Field with a higher run total than the Giants at the conclusion of all regulation and any extra innings played.

Clarifications:
- The official final score is determined by the MLB-recorded result; if the game is suspended and completed on a later date, the final score of the completed game governs; if the game is cancelled with no makeup and no official result is recorded, neither outcome wins.
